capabilities: Plan projects, milestones, tasks, logs, habits and events as markdown notes with frontmatter
Visualize the same data in Kanban, Timeline (Gantt), Calendar and Table views with filtering, search and drag-and-drop
Create and update items by talking to a voice/text Gemini Live assistant gated by confirmation modals
Pull Apple Calendar events into the vault as one-way, recurrence-aware event notes (macOS)
Scaffold per-project skill files so coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor can update tasks and append work logs
extras: Apple Calendar sync and possibly other features are macOS-only and hide themselves on other platforms. Security issues are handled via SECURITY.md rather than public issues. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan projects with multiple coordinated views (Kanban, Gantt, calendar) over plain markdown notes, or to drive planning with voice AI and external calendars.

relations.evidence: Talk to your planner — voice or text — via Google Gemini Live.
Pull any of your Apple Calendars into the vault as real Marvis events
the bundled marvis-project skill teaches Claude Code, Cursor, etc. how to pick tasks
the bundled marvis-project skill teaches Claude Code, Cursor, etc. how to pick tasks

requires.name: Apple Calendar (macOS) for calendar sync; Claude Code/Cursor for agent skill

summary: Multi-view project planner and habit tracker that stores projects, tasks, milestones, logs and events as markdown notes rendered in Kanban, Timeline, Calendar and Table views.
